sections.title: The ships are visible but their story needs a source
sections.bodyMarkdown:
A figure in a red robe with green fabric draped over it stands on rocky high ground, resting the right hand on the rightmost wand. Two more leafy wands are planted in the ground, one on either side. The person’s face is hidden from us. The stance looks steady and the gaze faces open water.

Yellow and gold-orange dominate the sky and water. A distant, uneven shoreline runs across the view, with several sailing vessels below. His reversed entry describes troubles and adversity coming to an end; that is not the same as “blocked expansion.” This article uses a separate, original reflective approach to the reversal, asking whether action sent into the world is receiving reliable feedback. The two approaches are not presented as one tradition.

sections.title: In everyday life
sections.bodyMarkdown:
### Sharing work publicly for the first time

After publishing, notice specific questions and how people use the work before deciding what to change. A little clear feedback can be valuable. Popularity alone need not determine whether the experiment was worthwhile.

### Working with an outside partner

Write down the deliverables, each person’s responsibilities and the next check-in. A partner’s different resources or experience can broaden what is possible, but spoken expectations still need to become arrangements both sides confirm.

### Making plans at a distance

Alongside imagining your next meeting, check the dates each person can manage and the practical constraints. Waiting can have visible progress without relying on guesses to sustain the connection.

articleMarkdown:
# Three of Wands: Notice how the world responds

Card: Three of Wands  
Card marking: III  
Minor Arcana · Wands  
Keywords: Expansion · Feedback · Cooperation

## At a glance

Upright: Things are moving out into the world. Watch for progress and new openings

Reversed: The response is slow to arrive. Check where the process has stalled

The figure in the Three of Wands turns away from us to watch ships on the water. Compared with the globe held in the Two, attention is now on something already taking place beyond the figure’s immediate reach.

## The ships are visible but their story needs a source

A figure in a red robe with green fabric draped over it stands on rocky high ground, resting the right hand on the rightmost wand. Two more leafy wands are planted in the ground, one on either side. The person’s face is hidden from us. The stance looks steady and the gaze faces open water.

Yellow and gold-orange dominate the sky and water. A distant, uneven shoreline runs across the view, with several sailing vessels below. The picture contains no cargo list and does not state whether the ships are arriving or departing. Their ownership and commercial story come from Waite’s text and should be distinguished from what the eye alone can see.

## The ships’ commercial story comes from Waite

Waite connects the Three of Wands with established strength, enterprise, effort, trade and discovery. In his account, the ships carry the figure’s merchandise. He also mentions able cooperation in business. The historical interpretation therefore includes both reaching outward and working with others.

His reversed entry describes troubles and adversity coming to an end; that is not the same as “blocked expansion.” This article uses a separate, original reflective approach to the reversal, asking whether action sent into the world is receiving reliable feedback. The two approaches are not presented as one tradition.

## Reading it upright

Upright, the card can describe a stage that calls for a wider circle of contact. An idea has become an action, and now it needs new readers, partners or users so the real world can provide information. You do not have to control every response, but you do need to know what kind of response you are waiting for.

Useful waiting has criteria. After showing a piece of work, perhaps you want to know what people find unclear; after a trial, which step takes the most effort. Cooperation also requires clarity about what each person contributes. A broader perspective need not mean taking on more things at once.

## Reading it reversed

The reversal can help locate a delay: was the information actually sent, did it reach suitable people, were the arrangements clear, and was the response time reasonable? Without checking those steps, it is difficult to distinguish ordinary waiting from a delay that needs attention.

Another question is whether you are watching distant possibilities so closely that you overlook your ability to follow through. When people respond, do you have time to continue the conversation, make changes or fulfil what you offered? Strengthening that capacity before expanding is often more useful than simply chasing responses.

## In everyday life

### Sharing work publicly for the first time

After publishing, notice specific questions and how people use the work before deciding what to change. A little clear feedback can be valuable. Popularity alone need not determine whether the experiment was worthwhile.

### Working with an outside partner

Write down the deliverables, each person’s responsibilities and the next check-in. A partner’s different resources or experience can broaden what is possible, but spoken expectations still need to become arrangements both sides confirm.

### Making plans at a distance

Alongside imagining your next meeting, check the dates each person can manage and the practical constraints. Waiting can have visible progress without relying on guesses to sustain the connection.

## A short exercise

Choose something you have already sent out. Write down whom it went to, the feedback you want, a reasonable waiting period and your next step. If any of those four is blank, fill it in before deciding whether to keep waiting.

## Common misreadings

The ships do not guarantee overseas opportunities or returns, and standing high does not mean the outcome is certain. The Three of Wands is useful for widening your perspective and reading feedback. It does not replace market research, checking agreements or observing actual responses.

## Artwork and English sources

- [A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, Part III §2, Three of Wands (1911-labelled English transcription)](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktwa03.htm)

sourceRecord.title: 权杖三 留意行动怎样得到回应
sourceRecord.uprightQuickTake: 事情已经往外走，留意进展和新的机会
sourceRecord.reversedQuickTake: 迟迟没等到回应，先查卡在哪个环节
sourceRecord.hook: 权杖三的人物背对我们，看着水面上的船。和掌中握着地球仪的权杖二相比，这一次，注意力已经放到正在外面发生的事上。
imageReading: 一名身穿红色长袍、披着绿色衣料的人站在岩石高处，右手搭在最右边的木杖上。另两根木杖一左一右插在地面，三根都带有绿叶。人物没有向观者展示脸，姿势显得稳定，视线朝向开阔的水面。
天空和水面主要呈黄色与金橙色，远处横着起伏的山岸，水上可见几艘带帆的船。牌图没有画出货物清单，也没有写明船要进港还是离港。船的归属与商业背景来自 Waite 的文字说明，应与单凭眼睛能看见的细节分开。
tradition: Waite 把权杖三联系到已经建立的力量、进取、努力、贸易与发现，并在自己的说明中认定这些船装载着人物的货物。他还提到有能力的商业合作。因此，这张牌的历史解释包含向外开展以及借助他人的部分。
他的逆位条目谈到困扰与艰难告一段落，并不等于“扩张受阻”。本篇的逆位另采用原创反思方法，检查行动送出去之后，是否能获得可靠的反馈；两者不混称为同一种传统。
uprightMeaning: 正位可以指向一个需要扩大接触面的阶段。想法已经做成了某种行动，现在要认识新的读者、伙伴或使用者，让真实世界提供信息。你不必控制每一个回应，却需要知道自己正等待哪一种回应。
有效的等待带有观察标准。比如，展示之后想知道别人哪里看不懂，试用之后想知道哪个步骤最费力。合作也需要说清彼此提供什么，而不是把“视野更广”误解成同时接下更多事情。
reversedMeaning: 逆位可用来检查停滞发生在哪一段：信息是否真的发出，接收者是否合适，约定是否清楚，反馈时间是否合理？如果这些环节没有确认，就很难区分正常等待与需要修正的延误。
另一个观察点是对远方投入过多注意，却忽视眼前的承接能力。有人开始回应时，是否有时间继续沟通、修改或履约？扩大范围之前补好这个环节，通常比单纯催促更有帮助。

situations.title: 第一次公开作品
situations.text: 发布后先观察具体问题与使用情况，再决定怎样改进。少量清楚的反馈也有价值，不能只用热度判断这次尝试是否值得。

situations.title: 与外部伙伴合作
situations.text: 把交付内容、各自负责人和下次同步时间写明。对方拥有你没有的资源或经验时，合作能拓展边界，但口头期待仍需要落实成双方确认的安排。

situations.title: 远距离的共同计划
situations.text: 除了想象未来见面，也要核对各自可以配合的日期与现实限制。等待可以有具体进度，不必靠猜测维持联系。

sourceRecord.practice: 选出一件已经“送出去”的事，写下发送对象、希望获得的反馈、合理的等待时间和下一步。若四项中有一项空白，先补上它，再判断是不是应该继续等待。
sourceRecord.commonMisread: 船只并不保证海外机会或收益，站在高处也不等于胜券在握。权杖三适合练习拓展视野与读取反馈，不能取代市场调查、约定核对或对实际回应的观察。
sourceRecord.sourceClaim: Waite 对贸易、进取、已有力量和协作的解释及船只归属说明；逆位旧义与现代受阻读法的区分。反馈管理是原创现代教学。
sourceRecord.imageReadingTitle: 看见了船 还要辨认船的故事
sourceRecord.readingApproach: 图像可见事实、Waite 历史解释与原创现代反思分别标示；正逆位是学习与自我反思提示，不用来确认未来、健康或他人隐秘行为。
sourceRecord.reverseMethod: 当代反思式读法，依据主题的受阻、失衡、过度或需要重新安排展开；不是对 Waite 旧逆位词条逐项翻译。
